paper_title: Laya-LoRA: Non-Autoregressive System 1 Decision Manifolds, Parameter-Efficient Attention Adaptation, and Microsecond Energy Optimization for Autonomous Neuro-Symbolic Agent Architectures
overall_recommendation: STRONG ACCEPT (Zenodo Pre-Print & Formal Conference Grade)

reviewers.evaluation: The paper cleanly resolves the systemic overhead of current multi-agent frameworks. By introducing Laya as an empirical System 1 gatekeeper, the system avoids routing routine queries into expensive System 2 reasoning provers. The five-dataset evaluation conclusively proves that structural decisions are captured within the single forward pass of ModernBERT. The proof of syntax drift eradication is sound.
strengths: Rigorous dual-process architecture separating microsecond triage from formal reasoning
Empirical proof of syntax drift eradication via topological decision manifolds
Demonstrated 85-90% routing avoidance away from costly autoregressive LLMs
weaknesses: Requires downstream multi-adapter orchestration when scaling to hundreds of niche subdomains

reviewers.evaluation: The energy formulation in Definition A aligns with the non-equilibrium thermodynamics of computation. Eliminating the autoregressive decoding loop fundamentally alters the computational complexity class from sequential memory-bound access to parallel compute-bound execution. The scale-to-zero Cloud Run deployment demonstrates Landauer efficiency: when no queries arrive, dissipation is strictly zero. Energy monotonicity is definitively satisfied.
strengths: Grounded in Landauer thermodynamic bounds and the ANSE physical energy functional
Zero idle power dissipation enabled by Knative scale-to-zero (minScale=0)
Zero-latency overhead proved via additive weight pre-folding theorem

reviewers.evaluation: The methodology avoids all synthetic simulations. The anti-stub verification protocol and cryptographic SHA256 digests in Table 2 provide absolute empirical reproducibility. The LoRA parameter budget (540,672 parameters, 0.3601% of total) adheres to strict micro-ML specifications, guaranteeing that ModernBERT's bidirectional contextual representation is preserved without catastrophic forgetting.
strengths: Complete zero-trust attestation with cryptographic proof tokens and tensor digests
Strict parameter budget (<600,000 parameters) preventing representation degradation
Empirical evaluation on 5 live, unmodified Hugging Face datasets
weaknesses: Evaluation currently scoped to 2-class, 5-class, 6-class, and 77-class heads; continuous regression loss could benefit from additional soft-label calibration
